jobs.title: Business Development Manager
jobs.description:
About GoodLeap:
GoodLeap is a technology company delivering best-in-class financing and software products for sustainable solutions, from solar panels and batteries to energy-efficient HVAC, heat pumps, roofing, windows, and more. Over 1 million homeowners have benefited from our simple, fast, and frictionless technology that makes the adoption of these products more affordable, accessible, and easier to understand. Thousands of professionals deploying home efficiency and solar solutions rely on GoodLeap’s proprietary, AI-powered applications and developer tools to drive more transparent customer communication, deeper business intelligence, and streamlined payment and operations. Our platform has led to more than $30 billion in financing for sustainable solutions since 2018.
 
GoodLeap is also proud to support our award-winning nonprofit, GivePower, which is building and deploying life-saving water and clean electricity systems, changing the lives of more than 1.6 million people across Africa, Asia, and South America.


The Business Development Manager will be instrumental in helping new Home Improvement Contractors join the GoodLeap family. This role will proactively identify and qualify prospective GoodLeap partners. Will collaborate with the Business Development team to ensure overall partner success. This role is all about helping Home Improvement Contractors access superior loan programs, and working with a fun, energetic group.

Essential Job Duties & Responsibilities:
- Proactively identify, qualify, and sign prospective GoodLeap partners; Works accounts under 2 million a year; coordinates handoff to outside sales team for anything over 2 million a year to outside sales team.

- Source new partnership opportunities through inbound lead follow-up and outbound cold calls and emails

- Develop a comprehensive knowledge of GoodLeap products and attributes, understand customer needs and requirements and help the two connect

- Work in collaboration with Business Development Directors to ensure partner success.  Provide best in class business intelligence driven guidance to your assigned partners to aid their growth and development

- Innovate on sales processes, pitches, and approaches; provide feedback and enhancements, collaborate with other GoodLeap teammates to continually improve a new initiative within a growing company

- Clearly explain and position technical issues such as financial products and legal agreements

- Interact with Executive team members to develop new and enhance existing programs
Required Skills, Knowledge & Abilities:
- Minimum 5 year’s experience:

- Selling to HI contractors and/or distributors

- Working for a HI contractor selling to homeowners utilizing finance to close deals

- Excellent verbal and written communication skills; experienced in engaging with all levels of an organization, from cross-functional teams to executive leadership.

- Skilled at clearly articulating ideas through client proposals, persuasive presentations, and strategic outreach materials that drive engagement and support business growth.

- Able to prioritize in a fast-paced environment

- Strong attention to detail

- Customer Focused

- Able to work with minimal supervision
Compensation: $60-$100k


Additional Information Regarding Job Duties and Job Descriptions:

Job duties include additional responsibilities as assigned by one's supervisor or other managers related to the position/department. This job description is meant to describe the general nature and level of work being performed; it is not intended to be construed as an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties and other skills required for the position. The Company reserves the right at any time with or without notice to alter or change job responsibilities, reassign or transfer job position or assign additional job responsibilities, subject to applicable law. The Company shall provide reasonable accommodations of known disabilities to enable a qualified applicant or employee to apply for employment, perform the essential functions of the job, or enjoy the benefits and privileges of employment as required by the law.

If you are an extraordinary professional who thrives in a collaborative work culture and values a rewarding career, then we want to work with you!  Apply today!

jobs.title: Sr. Manager, Marketing Systems & Automation
jobs.description:
About GoodLeap:
GoodLeap is a technology company delivering best-in-class financing and software products for sustainable solutions, from solar panels and batteries to energy-efficient HVAC, heat pumps, roofing, windows, and more. Over 1 million homeowners have benefited from our simple, fast, and frictionless technology that makes the adoption of these products more affordable, accessible, and easier to understand. Thousands of professionals deploying home efficiency and solar solutions rely on GoodLeap’s proprietary, AI-powered applications and developer tools to drive more transparent customer communication, deeper business intelligence, and streamlined payment and operations. Our platform has led to more than $30 billion in financing for sustainable solutions since 2018.
 
GoodLeap is also proud to support our award-winning nonprofit, GivePower, which is building and deploying life-saving water and clean electricity systems, changing the lives of more than 1.6 million people across Africa, Asia, and South America.


This position sits in the Marketing Operations team, building a next-generation MarTech stack: data-driven, AI-enabled, and made for the unique solutions being brought to the B2B and B2C market.
 
The Sr. Manager, Marketing Systems & Automation develops and executes omnichannel campaigns across all owned platforms, owns campaign design, coaches partner teams on best practices, and maintains system standards. The position helps assess new marketing tools and migrate existing processes onto them. Ultimately, the position converts manual campaign assembly into governed, supervised automation and builds the context, content, and data assets that AI-assisted marketing depends on.

Essential Job Duties and Responsibilities:
- Partner with product marketing, creative, and content to develop and execute omnichannel campaigns across all owned platforms — translating positioning and brand requirements into audience, channel, and journey design, and holding each campaign to explicit, agreed-upon KPIs from brief through post-launch readout.

- Build, deploy, and supervise automated and agent-assisted marketing workflows and internal tools, ensuring human-in-the-loop at the right time and properly tested workflows.

- Help maintain the MarTech Stack—keep good documentation, admin tools, coach and train on new systems, establish best practices across project, build and maintain AI skills and tools for marketing.

- Support the customer data foundation with Salesforce and Databricks partners; understand data infrastructure and be a steward of the data that feeds how we segment and measure campaigns.

- Campaign and channel performance reporting.
Required Skills, Knowledge and Abilities:
- Bachelor’s degree required in Marketing, Communications, or a related field

- 7-9 years in marketing operations, marketing automation, lifecycle and/or database marketing

- A documented history of successfully driving complex projects to completion

- Regulated industry experience preferred

- Hands-on ownership with a marketing automation/campaign execution platform, including audience construction, journey building, QA, and deliverability fundamentals

- Working understanding of SQL, HTML, and common marketing operations code; able to validate and troubleshoot it, including AI-generated output

- Ownership of campaign taxonomy and naming standards, UTM governance, and campaign hierarchy — able to define conventions others will actually follow, and enforce them without becoming a bottleneck

- Demonstrated experience building an automation, internal tool, or workflow beyond assigned work that others adopted

- Experience using AI tools for production work

- Ability to translate business and brand requirements into explicit, testable rules

- Sound judgment regarding data sensitivity, privacy, and disclosure in a consumer lending environment, including working knowledge of applicable data privacy law

- Curious, creative, and critical; an analytical thinker who can reconcile conflicting sources and distinguish a stated request from the underlying need

- Demonstrated ability to meet deadlines, handle and prioritize simultaneous requests, and manage laterally and upwards

- Exceptional verbal and written communication, and the ability to communicate effectively at all levels of the organization

- Experience migrating campaigns, audiences, and journeys between enterprise marketing automation platforms — including consent and preference state, suppression lists, and historical engagement data — is a plus

- Exercises discretion and independent judgement; able to work with autonomy
Compensation: $125,000 - $135,000 annually, plus bonus


Additional Information Regarding Job Duties and Job Descriptions:

Job duties include additional responsibilities as assigned by one's supervisor or other managers related to the position/department. This job description is meant to describe the general nature and level of work being performed; it is not intended to be construed as an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties and other skills required for the position.
